findings.summary: mintOperationPermit remains publicly reexported and can bypass the controlled issuer (no TransitionOffer+decision).
findings.acceptance_criteria: Stop reexporting mintOperationPermit from the public kernel API (or hard-deprecate so callers cannot mint without issueOperationPermit); add a negative test that public mint without decision fails closed.

findings.summary: findReplayReceipt / exact-replay short-circuit matches only operation+subject_id, not digests/arguments required by design.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Exact replay MUST bind arguments_digest (and other design digests); non-identical arguments MUST NOT short-circuit as replayed; add negative test.
